# Configuration

Settings live in `settings.json` in the data folder (`./data`, or `--data-dir`, or `PPE_GUARD_DATA_DIR`). The dashboard's **Settings** page edits the same file, and the server validates every change. An invalid file is moved aside to `settings.invalid.json` and defaults are used.

```json
{
  "general": {
    "site_name": "My site"
  },
  "detection": {
    "weights": "auto",
    "confidence": 0.4,
    "iou": 0.5,
    "imgsz": 640,
    "device": null,
    "tracker": "bytetrack.yaml",
    "max_fps": 15.0
  },
  "compliance": {
    "required_ppe": {
      "helmet": true,
      "vest": true,
      "mask": false
    },
    "violation_delay": 2.0,
    "clear_after": 3.0,
    "lost_timeout": 3.0,
    "treat_unseen_as_missing": false,
    "min_overlap": 0.5,
    "snapshot_interval": 10.0,
    "max_snapshots": 5
  },
  "alerts": {
    "webhook_url": null,
    "format": "generic",
    "cooldown": 60.0,
    "public_url": null
  },
  "recording": {
    "clips": true,
    "pre_seconds": 4.0,
    "max_seconds": 20.0,
    "fps": 8.0,
    "max_width": 800
  },
  "storage": {
    "retention_days": 0
  },
  "analysis": {
    "max_upload_mb": 500,
    "keep_jobs": 20
  },
  "cameras": [
    {
      "id": "webcam",
      "name": "Webcam",
      "source": "0",
      "enabled": true,
      "autostart": false,
      "loop": true,
      "zones": []
    }
  ]
}
```

## `general`

Site details.

| Key | Type | Default | Limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `general.site_name` | str | `"My site"` | min length 1, max length 80 | Shown in the dashboard, reports and alerts. |

## `detection`

How the model runs. `weights` needs a camera restart; the rest apply within a second.

| Key | Type | Default | Limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `detection.weights` | str | `"auto"` |  | Path, model alias (see `ppe-guard weights list`) or 'auto'. |
| `detection.confidence` | float | `0.4` | ≥ 0.01, ≤ 1 | Minimum detection confidence. Lower finds more, with more false alarms. |
| `detection.iou` | float | `0.5` | ≥ 0.05, ≤ 1 | NMS overlap threshold (ignored by NMS-free models). |
| `detection.imgsz` | int | `640` | ≥ 160, ≤ 1920 | Inference image size in pixels. |
| `detection.device` | str or null | `null` |  | 'cpu', '0', 'cuda:0', 'mps'... null = GPU if available. |
| `detection.tracker` | one of ['bytetrack.yaml', 'botsort.yaml'] | `"bytetrack.yaml"` |  | Multi-object tracker that keeps worker IDs across frames. |
| `detection.max_fps` | float | `15.0` | ≥ 1, ≤ 120 | Upper bound on processed frames per second. |

## `compliance`

What counts as a violation. Applies to every camera; PPE zones can override `required_ppe`.

| Key | Type | Default | Limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compliance.required_ppe` | RequiredPPE | (section) |  | Items every worker must wear. |
| `compliance.violation_delay` | float | `2.0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 60 | Seconds an item must look missing before a violation opens. |
| `compliance.clear_after` | float | `3.0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 300 | Seconds of compliance before an open violation closes. |
| `compliance.lost_timeout` | float | `3.0` | ≥ 0.1, ≤ 300 | Seconds a worker may be out of view before being forgotten. |
| `compliance.treat_unseen_as_missing` | bool | `false` |  | Strict mode: a required item that is not visible counts as missing. |
| `compliance.min_overlap` | float | `0.5` | > 0, ≤ 1 | Share of a PPE box that must lie inside a person box. |
| `compliance.snapshot_interval` | float | `10.0` | ≥ 1, ≤ 3600 | Seconds between snapshots of an ongoing violation. |
| `compliance.max_snapshots` | int | `5` | ≥ 1, ≤ 100 | Snapshots kept per violation. |

`compliance.required_ppe`:

| Key | Type | Default | Limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compliance.required_ppe.helmet` | bool | `true` |  | Hard hat required. |
| `compliance.required_ppe.vest` | bool | `true` |  | High-visibility safety vest required. |
| `compliance.required_ppe.mask` | bool | `false` |  | Face mask required. |

## `alerts`

Webhook alerts for new violations.

| Key | Type | Default | Limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alerts.webhook_url` | str or null | `null` |  | URL that receives a POST for each new violation. |
| `alerts.format` | one of ['generic', 'slack', 'discord'] | `"generic"` |  | Payload shape: generic JSON, Slack or Discord. |
| `alerts.cooldown` | float | `60.0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 86400 | Minimum seconds between alerts per camera. |
| `alerts.public_url` | str or null | `null` |  | Dashboard address included in alert messages, e.g. https://ppe.example.com |

## `recording`

Video clips saved with each violation.

| Key | Type | Default | Limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `recording.clips` | bool | `true` |  | Save a short video clip with every violation. |
| `recording.pre_seconds` | float | `4.0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 30 | Seconds of video kept from before a violation. |
| `recording.max_seconds` | float | `20.0` | ≥ 2, ≤ 120 | Longest clip, including the pre-roll. |
| `recording.fps` | float | `8.0` | ≥ 1, ≤ 30 | Frame rate of saved clips. |
| `recording.max_width` | int | `800` | ≥ 320, ≤ 1920 | Clips are scaled down to this width. |

## `storage`

How long data is kept.

| Key | Type | Default | Limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `storage.retention_days` | int | `0` | ≥ 0, ≤ 3650 | Delete violations, snapshots and clips older than this. 0 keeps everything. |

## `analysis`

Limits for the Analyze page.

| Key | Type | Default | Limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `analysis.max_upload_mb` | int | `500` | ≥ 1, ≤ 10000 | Largest file accepted by Analyze. |
| `analysis.keep_jobs` | int | `20` | ≥ 1, ≤ 500 | Finished analysis jobs to keep on disk. |

## `cameras`

A list of cameras. Add them in **Settings → Cameras** or with the API.

| Key | Type | Default | Limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cameras[].id` | str | required |  | Short slug, e.g. 'gate-north'. |
| `cameras[].name` | str | required | min length 1, max length 80 | Display name. |
| `cameras[].source` | str | required | min length 1 | Webcam index ('0'), file path, or rtsp/http URL. |
| `cameras[].enabled` | bool | `true` |  | Disabled cameras cannot be started. |
| `cameras[].autostart` | bool | `false` |  | Start this camera when the server starts. |
| `cameras[].loop` | bool | `true` |  | Restart video files when they end. |
| `cameras[].zones` | list[Zone] | `[]` |  | PPE and no-entry zones (see below). |

### Zones

Each camera has a list of zones, drawn in the zone editor. Points are normalised to 0-1 (x to the right, y down).

| Key | Type | Default | Limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cameras[].zones[].id` | str | required |  | Short slug, unique per camera. |
| `cameras[].zones[].name` | str | required | min length 1, max length 60 | Shown on the video and in violations. |
| `cameras[].zones[].kind` | one of ['ppe', 'restricted'] | `"ppe"` |  | 'ppe': check PPE inside. 'restricted': nobody may enter. |
| `cameras[].zones[].points` | list[tuple[float, float]] | required | min length 3, max length 64 | Polygon corners as [x, y] pairs in 0-1. |
| `cameras[].zones[].required_ppe` | RequiredPPE or null | `null` |  | PPE zones only: items required inside this zone (default: global rule). |
| `cameras[].zones[].enabled` | bool | `true` |  | Disabled zones are kept but ignored. |

## Environment variables

| Variable | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `PPE_GUARD_DATA_DIR` | Data folder (settings, database, snapshots, clips). Default `./data`. |
| `PPE_GUARD_MODELS_DIR` | Where model weights are stored and downloaded. Default `./models`. |
| `PPE_GUARD_PASSWORD` | Dashboard password. Set at every start, replacing one set in the UI. |
